column1: # derivation: scan_key_order holds scan_rows' four rows with each line's
# members in another order. A JSON object is an unordered collection of
# name/value pairs (RFC 8259 §4), so each member binds to the declared column
# of its name and the rows equal explicit_null_and_empty's: null is NULL and
# "" is '' (§7.13, proposed; §7.12). The columns come out in the declared
# order, id x s. No sort: compared as a multiset (§4.8).
